title: GrowthBook button
description: Tall, plain product-site buttons with an 8px radius: a solid brand violet that darkens on hover, and a hairline outline whose border turns to the text colour. Optional trailing arrow; can go full-width on phones.
notes: 58px tall at md and lg (as on the original), 44px at sm (header)
name: growthbook-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: solid brand violet · outline: hairline border, transparent fill

props.name: arrow
props.description: a right arrow after the label

props.name: blockOnMobile
props.description: full width below the md breakpoint (the original's phone buttons)
